gate: 21 - Held-out Fresh-Task Efficacy (LRPE v0.7 Coverage-Budgeted Drafting)
benchmark: Harvey Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), pinned public commit
primary_endpoint: Harvey criterion all-pass per unique task

pass_thresholds.note: all_pass_delta_min is unused: task all-pass was degenerate (0 for both arms) in Gate 20. Replaced by rule task_wins_ge_losses (tasks where v0.7 criterion-pass beats control >= tasks where it loses).

strong_evidence_rule: Paired task bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 for criterion-pass delta; reported separately and not required for pilot PASS.
interpretation: Pass = held-out pilot efficacy for v0.7 on 20 unseen tasks; same-model judge; not deployment certification.
selection_rule: Pools: Harvey LAB tasks whose directory begins analyze-/assess- (analysis stratum, 14) and compare- (6), at the pinned commit, excluding all 20 Gate 20 tasks; seeded shuffle (21021 / 21022), max 2 tasks per practice area. Harvey has no unused research-named tasks, so the stratum key 'pure_research' in the files denotes the analysis stratum.
primary_goal: Test whether v0.7 (deliverable ledger + word-budgeted dense drafting) improves Harvey criterion pass rate over control on previously unused tasks.
run_integrity_rule: Before judging, each submission is checked that its final_answer concerns its assigned task (document-name overlap check). A run that fails is re-run once in a fresh context with a run-unique scratch directory; both attempts are logged. Runner agents must write any scratch files only under /tmp/<run_id>/ to prevent cross-run contamination (observed in Gate 20 run RD4105E551F1F).
development_data: v0.7 was designed using only aggregate Gate 20 diagnostics (failure-type counts, word counts, run-integrity finding). No Gate 20 rubric text or task content was used.
